title: 第1章 不为自己怼一场岂不是白穿越了第2章 敲诈不成反被敲
slug: 全宗开挂大师姐她就爱贴脸开大
lines: “弟子相信芷晴没有偷云卿师妹的清心圣灵丹！”
清冷的厉喝从硕大的广场中心突兀响彻，围在一起交头接耳看热闹的众弟子被吓了一跳，惊愕的看向林筱，殊不知，林筱比他们更懵逼。
仿佛是看出了林筱的茫然，前方一身道袍看上去格外仙风道骨的三长老不满皱眉，“你吼什么？你说诗芷晴没有偷云卿的清心圣灵丹，你有什么证据吗？”
林筱紧绷着脸，周围人见她这副样子还以为她要放大招说一些震惊他们所有人话，结果下一秒，林筱抬起手，狠掐了自己一下。
会疼，完了，真让她赶上穿越潮流了。
记忆涌来，林筱才知道她穿越进了她小妹给她推荐的一本名叫《全修真界都是我养的鱼》的小说里，成了里面最憋屈的大师姐。
女主洛云卿因好奇闯入了宗门禁地，出来就被废了根骨修为，她的师父，也就是刚才不满质问她的那位三长老，为了给洛云卿恢复根骨，不惜动用魔功，想要找一个和洛云卿体质相似的人，把那人的根骨挖出来安在洛云卿身上。
天衍宗九位亲传，只有排名末尾的诗芷晴属性和洛云卿相似，于是三长老伪造了一个洛云卿中毒的假象，诬陷诗芷晴为了突破金丹偷取洛云卿的解药，不容诗芷晴辩解便将人逐出的宗门。
原身总觉得哪里不对，悄悄追出宗门，不追不知道，一追吓一跳，她看见三长老和洛云卿在扒诗芷晴的皮。
三长老发现原身，心一狠，干脆一不做二不休把原身也杀死了，回去说原身出门历练死于意外。
而洛云卿则成功换上了诗芷晴的根骨，等于重活了一遍。
她这回无比珍惜自己的命，努力修炼，凭借着女主光环很快吸引来了一大群为她痴迷的人。
天衍宗那五个男亲传就不说了，关键是就连亲传二师姐蒋凤熙都被洛云卿打动，加入了女主的后宫中。
自此，女主达成了男女通吃成就，开启了自己在修真界养鱼的没羞没臊的生活。
回忆完剧情，只有一个符号能表达此刻林筱的内心。
能写出这样剧情的作者家里那两位还好吗？
见林筱只是愣着不说话，旁边的大长老也忍不住出声了：“林筱，你拿不出证据为诗芷晴辩解就退下吧，我知道你不想看诗芷晴受罚，可宗有宗规，我天衍宗不留品行不良的败类。”
“弟子没有！”
跪在地上的诗芷晴哭着抬头，大声为自己喊冤：“弟子真的没有，弟子明知道那清心圣灵丹是云卿师妹的救命药物，又怎么可能会去偷呢！”
三长老给了身旁弟子一个眼神，那弟子了然的站出来。
“什么没偷，肯定是你为了突破金丹趁云卿师妹不注意溜进她的洞府中偷了丹药，那可是云卿师妹的救命丹药，你怎么好意思偷的！”
“突破金丹固然重要，可以这样的手段换取的金丹，用着不觉羞耻吗！”
“大长老，快把她赶出天衍宗！
她这样心思狠毒，品行败坏的人根本不配做我们天衍宗的弟子，更不配当我们的师姐！”
站着三长老这边的弟子也纷纷跟着附和，“对！
把她赶出天衍宗！
赶出天衍宗！”
林筱深吸一口气，总算是接受了自己穿越的事实，听着周围弟子的喊声，不知道诗芷晴是什么想法，反正她是忍不了了。
看书时她就被这段剧情气的半死，现在来了，不给当时的自己出出气，岂不是白穿越一趟？
抬头环顾，那些被三长老收买的弟子就不说了，令林筱厌恶的是那些不明真相，但看热闹不嫌事大跟风喊的弟子。
看戏就看戏，你喊什么呢？
content_en:
"Disciple believes that Zhi Qing did not steal Junior Sister Yunqing's Pure Heart Holy Spirit Pill!"
A cold and sharp shout suddenly resounded from the center of the huge square. The disciples who were gathered together, whispering and watching the excitement, were startled and looked at Lin Xiao in shock. Little did they know that Lin Xiao was even more confused than them.
As if seeing Lin Xiao's confusion, the third elder in front of him, who was wearing a Taoist robe and looked particularly immortal, frowned dissatisfied, "What are you yelling at? You said Shi Zhiqing did not steal Yun Qing's Pure Heart Holy Spirit Pill. Do you have any evidence?"
Lin Xiao's face was tense. When people around her saw her look like this, they thought she was going to say something that would shock them all. However, the next second, Lin Xiao raised her hand and pinched herself hard.
Everyone: "?"
Lin Xiao: "...hiss!"
It would hurt. It was over. It really made her catch up on the time travel trend.
Memories came flooding back, and Lin Xiao realized that she had time-traveled into a novel called "The Whole Cultivation World Is My Fish" recommended to her by her younger sister, and became the most aggrieved senior sister in it.
The heroine Luo Yunqing broke into the sect's restricted area out of curiosity, and was deprived of her bones when she came out. Her master, the third elder who just questioned her dissatisfiedly, did not hesitate to use magic power to restore Luo Yunqing's bones. He wanted to find someone with a similar physique to Luo Yunqing, dig out that person's bones and install them on Luo Yunqing.
Among the nine direct disciples of Tianyan Sect, only Shi Zhiqing, who ranked at the bottom, had similar attributes to Luo Yunqing. So the third elder made up the illusion that Luo Yunqing was poisoned, framed Shi Zhiqing for stealing Luo Yunqing's antidote in order to break through the golden elixir, and expelled Shi Zhiqing from the sect without allowing Shi Zhiqing to defend himself.
The original person always felt that something was wrong, so she quietly chased her out of the sect. She would not have known if she had not chased her, but when she chased her, she was startled. She saw the third elder and Luo Yunqing peeling off Shi Zhiqing's skin.
When the third elder discovered the original body, he was so cruel that he killed the original body without any further action. When he returned, he said that the original body had died in an accident while going out for training.
Luo Yunqing successfully replaced Shi Zhiqing's bones, which was equivalent to living a new life.
This time she cherished her life extremely, worked hard to practice, and quickly attracted a large group of people obsessed with her with her heroine aura.
Let’s not talk about the five male descendants of Tianyan Sect. The key point is that even the second senior sister Jiang Fengxi was moved by Luo Yunqing and joined the heroine’s harem.
Since then, the heroine has achieved the achievement of being a male and female, and started her shameless life of raising fish in the world of cultivation.
After recalling the plot, only one symbol can express Lin Xiao's heart at this moment.
"..."
How are the two authors in the family who can write such a plot?
Seeing that Lin Xiao was just dumbfounded and silent, the elder beside him couldn't help but speak out: "Lin Xiao, if you can't provide evidence to defend Shi Zhiqing, just step back. I know you don't want to see Shi Zhiqing punished, but the sect has sect rules, and our Tianyan sect does not keep scum with bad conduct."
"No disciple!"
Shi Zhiqing, who was kneeling on the ground, raised her head in tears and cried out for herself: "Disciple, I really don't have any. I know clearly that the Pure Heart Holy Spirit Pill is a life-saving medicine for Junior Sister Yunqing, so how could I steal it!"
The third elder gave the disciple next to him a look, and the disciple stood up clearly.
"You didn't steal anything. You must have sneaked into Junior Sister Yunqing's cave to steal the elixir in order to break through the golden elixir. That was Junior Sister Yunqing's life-saving elixir. How could you have the nerve to steal it!"
"It's important to break through the golden elixir, but don't you feel ashamed to use the golden elixir that can be exchanged for it in this way!"
"Great Elder, drive her out of Tianyan Sect quickly!
Someone with such a vicious mind and corrupt conduct is not worthy of being a disciple of our Tianyan Sect, let alone our senior sister! "
The disciples standing on the third elder’s side also echoed, “Yes!
Drive her out of Tianyan Sect!
Drive out Tianyan Sect! "
Lin Xiao took a deep breath and finally accepted the fact that she had traveled through time. Listening to the shouts of the disciples around her, she didn't know what Shi Zhiqing was thinking. Anyway, she couldn't bear it anymore.
When she was reading the book, she was so angry that she was half-dead by this plot. Now that she was here, if she didn't vent her anger on her then, wouldn't it be a waste of time traveling through time?
Looking up and looking around, not to mention the disciples who had been bribed by the third elder, what made Lin Xiao disgusted were the disciples who didn't know the truth, but just watched the excitement and followed the trend without taking it too seriously.
Just watch a show, what do you shout?
title_en: Chapter 1 If you don’t fight for yourself, wouldn’t it be a waste of time? Chapter 2 If you fail to blackmail, you will be blackmailed.
